[Intro]
[C]You shake my nerves and you
rattle my brain
[F7]Too much love drives a
man insane
[G7]You broke my will
[F7]But what a thrill
[C]Goodness gracious, great
balls of fire!

[Verse 1]
[C]I laughed at love 'cause I
thought it was funny
[F7]You came along and you
moved me honey
[G7]I've changed my mind
[F7]This love is fine
[C]Goodness gracious, great
balls of fire!

[Chorus]
[F7]Kiss me baby
Ooh,
[C]
it feels good
[F7]Hold me baby,
yeah

[Bridge]
[G7]I want to love you like a
lover should
You're fine,
so kind
I'm gon' tell this world that you're
mine, mine, mine, mine

[Verse 2]
[C]I chew my nails, I
twiddle my thumbs
[F7]I'm gettin' nervous honey,
but it sure is fun
[G7]Come on baby,
[F7]you drive me crazy
[C]Goodness gracious, great
balls of fire!
